The battery sometimes drains because the app keeps running in the background. Everything was fine and I hadn't had any issues, but now it turns out that you have to pay a $30 monthly membership to get more accurate data, which seems way too excessive.

It was originally free. As a user, I don't think there is a problem with paying a monthly subscription, but $30 a month is too much. Other apps offer this for free, and it is just not worth it anymore, especially since you don't get priority unless you pay.
